morbi.headline: Morbi ceramic hub benefits from freight drops amid export cost pressures.
what_changed: Container freight rates dropped by up to 50 percent for Morbi ceramics.
Somany Ceramics announced a 5 MSM capacity hike via debottlenecking.
stress_signals: Indian ceramic tile industry is facing export market challenges and rising production cost pressures [895aa138960b].
improvement_signals: Ocean container freight rates dropped by up to 50 percent, providing relief to exporters [d6c30857de2c].
what_to_watch: Monitor export volume recovery and margin improvements following freight rate reductions.
Track working capital cycles and debt servicing for units impacted by rising production costs [895aa138960b].

surat.headline: Surat cluster shows recovering diamond demand and policy momentum alongside persistent textile fraud and demand divergence.
what_changed: Surat Textile Policy approved 627 units representing an investment of Rs 1,521 crore [021c037e28d9].
Diamond cutting and polishing units planned early reopening after vacations due to improving demand, while MMF textile demand remained muted [d6a824e747af, bd78e4a130ff].
MANTRA expanded into MedTech by launching medical textile testing services [5e7cd22236e9].
stress_signals: SGCCI sought stringent GUJCTOC act against organized gangs defrauding the Surat textile market of crores [421d4bf835f5].
Ahmedabad traders were arrested for defrauding Surat textile merchants of over Rs 22 lakh by failing to clear payments [f699b1f05b5e].
Diamond units faced pre-Diwali closures due to rough diamond shortages despite market revival [b65b93c4b724], and a Jain diamond merchant committed suicide [9edf027a29a8].
improvement_signals: Diamond trade witnessed a return of vibrancy following a four-year recession, with rising LGD demand and 10% worker bonuses [bae3b8d48691, 751cd1661531].
SGCCI signed two MoUs in Morocco to boost Surat textile exports [472a28abf217].
what_to_watch: Implementation timelines and operational execution of the 627 units under the Surat Textile Policy [021c037e28d9].
Rough diamond supply constraints affecting cutting and polishing unit operations [b65b93c4b724].
Payment defaults and trade receivables behavior in the MMF textile market [421d4bf835f5, f699b1f05b5e].
